task_description: Fix the Cognito redirect_mismatch that fails the realtime-battle HOST login (admin-page login works). Root cause: the battle host lives in the public app which Amplify serves at the ROOT URL, so auth.ts sends redirect_uri = origin + '/', but Cognito only trusts origin + '/index.html' and '/admin.html'. Fix by canonicalizing the host redirect to the ROOT (origin + '/') in the frontend AND registering that exact string in the CDK Cognito app client, keeping '/admin.html' working. Both sides must match byte-for-byte. Update the CDK jest test and README deploy notes.
